get.summary: Gateway, camera and robot controller health
get.description: No authentication. status is ok when the camera delivers current frames and the robot controller answers over Robot Web Services, otherwise degraded; the details say which part is down and why. Always 200 while the gateway runs.

get.summary: Get the end-effector pose of both arms

schema.title: Response Get Arm Poses Api V1 Robot Arms Get

get.summary: Get the end-effector pose of one arm
get.description: Without parameters the arm's active tool and work object are used. coordinate is the frame the pose is given in.

get.summary: Get the joint angles of one arm
Get the finger position of one arm's gripper
get.description: position in mm on the SmartGripper's scale (0 closed .. 25 fully open, as POST /robot/rws/gripper move uses it), read from the gripper's own position signal; after a grip it is where the fingers stopped on the object. 404 on a controller without the SmartGripper (RobotStudio).

get.summary: Get RAPID execution state and loaded program modules

put.summary: Upload and load a RAPID module into a task
put.description: Replaces a loaded module with the same name. RAPID must be stopped. The source must declare MODULE <module>.

delete.summary: Unload a RAPID module from a task

post.summary: Start RAPID execution in all tasks
post.description: Starts from the current program pointer, or from main with reset_program_pointer. Needs motors on in auto mode.

post.summary: Stop RAPID execution in all tasks
Move an arm over Robot Web Services
post.description: Writes the target into the arm's RAPID task (rapid/) and waits for the move to finish. arm is left (default) or right; tool0 in wobj0, mm and degrees; without rx/ry/rz the orientation is kept. A target outside the gateway's safe zone (ERR outside safe zone, nothing is sent) or out of reach (ERR move failed) gives accepted=false. 409 if RAPID is not running or the arm is busy, 504 on timeout. With wait=false it answers STARTED once the job is written; poll GET /robot/rws/status. speed is the TCP speed in mm/s (default 50, RAPID v50), acceleration and ramp are RAPID AccSet's in % (default 100); they also apply to later legacy /robot/command moves of that arm.

post.summary: Move an arm to its home position over Robot Web Services
post.description: Body optional; arm is left (default) or right. ERR move failed if the arm stopped before reaching home (blocked). speed, acceleration and ramp as for /move.

post.summary: Close, open or set the opening of an arm's gripper over Robot Web Services
post.description: action grip closes until the fingers hold something, with optional force in N (0 < force <= 20, default 20, the SmartGripper's maximum); open opens fully; move goes to position, the opening between the fingers in mm (0 closed to 25 fully open), from either side and without holding force. position only with move, force only with grip (422 otherwise). 409 if the RAPID program predates move or force (upload rapid/ again). wait as for /move. The last force also applies to later legacy GRIP commands of that arm.

get.summary: State of an arm's last job
get.description: Same answers as the team's CommServer STATUS: BUSY while the arm works on a job (also one started by another client), then DONE or ERR move failed (accepted=false). For jobs started with wait=false.

ArmPose.description: End-effector pose of one arm, as a RAPID robtarget.

GripperState.title: GripperState
GripperState.description: Finger position of one arm's SmartGripper.

RwsGripperRequest.title: RwsGripperRequest
RwsGripperRequest.description:
One gripper job.

grip closes until the fingers hold something (or are closed),
with force N (default 20, the SmartGripper's maximum); open
opens fully; move goes to position, the opening between the
fingers in mm (0 closed .. 25 fully open), in either direction
and without holding force (SmartGripper g_MoveTo).

RwsMotionRequest.title: RwsMotionRequest
RwsMotionRequest.description:
A job that moves the arm (move or home).

Left out, each value is the gateway's default
(GATEWAY_RWS_DEFAULT_SPEED / _ACCELERATION / _RAMP).

RwsMoveRequest.title: RwsMoveRequest
RwsMoveRequest.description:
Target of one arm's tool0 in wobj0 (default the left arm).

Position in mm. The rotation, in degrees, is optional and
means the same as RAPID's OrientZYX(rz, ry, rx); without it
the arm keeps its current orientation.
